entities.summary: Fritz August Breuhaus was a German architect, interior designer, and designer in the 20th century. He added “de Groot” to the end of his name in 1929. He spread the word of this addition claiming to be the grandson/great-grandson of reputable painter Breuhaus de Groot. His father, Heinrich Hugo Breuhaus, was a dentist and married to his mother Johanne Knipping.
